method: Fetched and decoded all 277 medium images again, verified the SHA-256 of each against the manifest, computed 64-bit horizontal dHash, and flagged Hamming distance <=4.
assessment: These are review candidates, not proven duplicate frames or the same individual plant. All three pairs have different observation IDs but matching attribution within each pair, so observation-ID-only splitting is unsafe. The shared attribution is from photo metadata, not a verified account ID.
limitations: A 64-bit difference hash can miss crops, flips and large edits and falsely flag similar leaf patterns.
GBIF/base image bytes and the 99-gap candidate bytes were not included in this run.
Botanical identity, current photo-license status, indoor relevance and independent smartphone test have not been certified.
No candidate photos admitted to training.
